2608.29419.title: Scalable Clinical Data Infrastructure and Comparative ML Evaluation for Hospitalisation Risk Prediction in Elderly Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions using CPRD
2608.29419.paper_summary: Deep learning architectures are increasingly proposed for patient trajectory modeling in electronic health records (EHRs), yet their advantage over simpler, more interpretable models is rarely subjected to rigorous empirical scrutiny in real-world clinical settings. We present a comprehensive patient timeline pipeline applied to elderly patients in CPRD Aurum, incorporating 260 clinical conditions classified via a three-tier automated framework including specialised detection logic for 17 complex conditions. Using this infrastructure, we benchmark Temporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (TG-CNN) against Logistic Regression with LASSO regularisation and Random Forests for predicting 12-month all-cause emergency hospitalisation risk, motivated by (but not filtered to) the elevated risk of adverse drug reactions. Under cross-validation, TG-CNN achieves a marginally higher mean AUC-ROC than LASSO (0.712 vs. 0.705), whereas on the held-out test set LASSO achieves the highest discrimination of three models (AUC-ROC 0.733, versus 0.710 for Random Forest and 0.702 for TG-CNN). We show, that discrimination alone is an incomplete criterion for clinical deployment: after Platt calibration, LASSO is the only model with an acceptable calibration slope (0.817), while Random Forest (0.759) and, TG-CNN (0.391) remain substantially miscalibrated. We argue that LASSO, not the highest-discriminating model, is the model best suited to direct clinical deployment. We present lessons for the machine learning and healthcare community regarding data infrastructure, model selection, and value of calibration and interpretability in high-stakes decision support.
2608.29419.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習架構越來越多地被提議用於電子健康紀錄 (EHRs) 中的患者軌跡建模，但它們相對於更簡單、更具可解釋性的模型的優勢在現實世界的臨床環境中很少受到嚴格的實證檢驗。我們提出了一個應用於 CPRD Aurum 中老年患者的綜合患者時間線管道，包含 260 種臨床狀況，這些狀況通過一個三層自動化框架進行分類，並包括對 17 種複雜狀況的專門檢測邏輯。利用這一基礎設施，我們將時間圖卷積神經網絡 (TG-CNN) 與帶 LASSO 正則化的邏輯回歸和隨機森林進行基準測試，以預測 12 個月的全因急診住院風險，這是基於（但不僅限於）不良藥物反應的升高風險。在交叉驗證下，TG-CNN 的平均 AUC-ROC 略高於 LASSO（0.712 對 0.705），而在保留的測試集上，LASSO 的三個模型中達到了最高的區分度（AUC-ROC 0.733，相較於隨機森林的 0.710 和 TG-CNN 的 0.702）。我們顯示，僅僅依賴區分度並不是臨床部署的完整標準：經過 Platt 校準後，LASSO 是唯一一個具有可接受校準斜率（0.817）的模型，而隨機森林（0.759）和 TG-CNN（0.391）仍然存在顯著的錯誤校準。我們主張，LASSO 而不是最高區分度的模型，是最適合直接臨床部署的模型。我們為機器學習和醫療保健社區提供了關於數據基礎設施、模型選擇以及在高風險決策支持中校準和可解釋性價值的教訓。
